If customer wants to continue phone conversation at another time:
"I'm happy to continue this discussion at a more convenient time. When might be best for you?"
(agree on a time with customer for you to call them back)
“I will speak to you again <repeat time and date agreed>.”
(END CALL)

If customer
• doesn’t want to continue phone conversation at another time, AND/OR
• prefers a written response

“Thank you for your time today. I’ll send you my written response to your complaint.”
(END CALL)

If customer
• refuses to speak to you to discuss the complaint at all, AND
• says they don’t want a written response either:

“ANZ has an obligation to give you a written response. However, if you don’t want this, we can withdraw your complaint. Would you like me to do that on your behalf?”

(If customer says yes – withdraw complaint)
(If customer says no – explain to customer):

“Unfortunately, as you don’t want to withdraw the complaint, we are required to send you a written response which will include AFCA’s details so you can escalate further if you wish.”
